about.title: about
about.paragraph_1: the image of women in the truck-driving profession is dual: on the one hand, images of women are meant to remind drivers of family warmth, peace, and the comfort of home, which are often missing on long journeys. on the other hand, this image is frequently associated with sexualised depictions of women, distorting its original meaning—to be a symbol of support, comfort, and emotional reassurance.
about.paragraph_2: the image of the woman becomes indistinct, losing its clear contours and authenticity. the blurred picture becomes a visual equivalent of longing and loneliness on the road, when reality grows less distinct and fantasies and distorted images fill the void.
